messages:
maria_finance: Quick heads-up — prepping the PriceWave experiment for Thursday's billing run. Need a quick ledger-to-invoice mapping sanity check and signoff before we flip shadow->live for cohort B. Shadow totals look close but we surfaced two issues: rounding delta on high-volume accounts and promo carryover for legacy entitlements. Attaching a sample CSV of invoice rows below.

sam_billing: can you drop the CSV here? also what's the rounding rule you used? bankers rounding or floor?

maria_finance: pasted sample below. we used bankers rounding (round half to even) to match ledger preprocessor. if preferred we can switch to round-down for invoice generation, but that changes revenue recognition numbers.

maria_finance: ```account_id,invoice_id,period_start,period_end,usage_units,unit_price,raw_amount,rounded_amount
acct_1001,inv_9001,2026-03-01,2026-03-31,1_234_567,0.0008,987.6536,987.65
acct_2002,inv_9002,2026-03-01,2026-03-31,12,0.05,0.6000,0.6
acct_3003,inv_9003,2026-03-01,2026-03-31,345_678,0.0008,276.5424,276.54
```

sam_billing: ok seeing the delta. for acct_1001 the 0.0036 rounding spreads across thousands of customers, can we tolerate that? finance tolerance is < $500 daily for experiment.

nina_growth: we should also confirm promo carryover behavior — folks on the legacy flat-credit plan should not auto-lose credits when they hit the A bucket. for PriceWave experiment we intended to phase credits down over 3 billing cycles, not immediate removal.

aj_sales: +1 on notifying top impacted customers. we should prepare a short outreach note for top 20 accounts where delta > $50. who owns the list?

maria_finance: I'll generate the top-20 delta list after final reconcile. script below to compute delta and tag accounts for outreach. pls review if it matches ops fields.

maria_finance: ```-- delta calc
SELECT account_id, SUM(rounded_amount - raw_amount) AS delta_cents
FROM pricewave_shadow
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING ABS(SUM(rounded_amount - raw_amount)) > 5000; -- > $50
```

ben_ops: on gating: ops will hold the cohort B toggle until finance confirms ledger match and sales approves outreach. timeline?

maria_finance: prefer to gate until Thu 09:00 PT. if we get signoff before 07:00 PT we can do a dry-run and validate invoice generation. otherwise delay 24h.

billing-bot: Automated snapshot created: s3://redwood-billing/pricewave/snapshots/2026-03-10T02-15Z/ledger-snapshot.csv (size: 4.2MB)

sam_billing: I ran a quick compare of sample rows vs snapshot, found a mapping mismatch on vendor_fee field for rows where vendor = "edge-accelerate". sample shows vendor_fee in cents, snapshot in dollars. looks like unit mismatch at ingestion.

maria_finance: omg good catch. that explains a ~0.5% variance. ben, can ops patch the ingest transformer to normalize vendor_fee -> cents? quick patch will be: multiply vendor_fee by 100 when vendor in ("edge-accelerate","fast-store").

ben_ops: yes we can push a hotfix to staging and re-run shadow. will need 30min and a deploy window.

nina_growth: also confirm promo mapping for legacy entitlements: new experiment field is `phase_credit_percent`. please ensure it gets merged into invoice_lines with precedence over default credits. we don't want accidental double-dipping.

maria_finance: noted. I'll update the mapping doc and attach final CSV before 06:30 PT. if everyone +1s the mapping I'll mark finance signoff. aj_sales, will you OK outreach wording when I send the top-20?

aj_sales: yes, send me the list + short note draft. prefer language that offers a one-time credit if delta > $100.

sam_billing: once ingest fix is in, i'll run full reconcile and post delta summary. plan to publish a final delta report by 08:00 PT.

maria_finance: thanks all — next steps: 1) ben deploys ingest patch to staging (30m) 2) sam re-runs reconcile and posts delta summary 3) maria publishes top-20 + outreach draft 4) ops holds B toggle until finance+sales signoff. ping me in thread when done. :pray:
